About Fibe (formerly Early Salary): Fibe is one of Indias leading consumer lending apps focused on young, aspirational, and tech-savvy Indian consumers. It is building a financial ecosystem that enables the mid-income group and the underserved segments to fulfil their financial aspirations. Fibe offers a range of financial products, including cash loans, long-term personal loans, and Impact loans for sectors like Healthcare, Education, Green Finance, Loan Against Mutual Funds, making affordability more accessible. Fibe has grown multifold over the years and emerged as a market leader in providing financial assistance to young middle-income and underserved groups in India. Due to its scalable business model, Fibe has recently been upgraded to A- by CARE Ratings and has access to debt lines from leading banks, NBFCs and wholesale debt markets. It has been certified with ISO/IEC 27001 for its Information Security Management System (ISMS). Fibe has disbursed more than 9.8 million+ loans worth Rs. 48,000 Cr+ since inception through its lending partners. • Winner of BW Festival of Fintech Lending Platform of the Year (Gold) and Fintech Brand of the Year (Silver) • ET Healthcare Awards 2024 - Excellence in Affordable Healthcare Financing • Entrepreneur 2024 Founder of The Year & Best Innovation in Financial Services • Winner of G20 Digital Innovation Alliance – Best Startup in Fintech • Great Place to Work Certified 
 Location: Pune (on-site) Type: Full-time, 5 days a week Experience: 3+ years 
 About the role: We're looking for a UI/UX Designer who can own a project end to end from understanding the problem to shipping a polished, well-thought-out screen. This is a UI-first role: your visual craft needs to be strong, sharp, and consistent. UX thinking should back that craft up, not replace it. You should be someone who obsesses over spacing, type, hierarchy, and motion just as much as you think about user flows and edge cases. You'll also be expected to work fast using AI tools as part of your everyday process not as a novelty, but as a real part of how you design, explore, and ship. 
 What you'll do: Own design projects end to end from brief to research inputs to final, developer-ready UI Design high-quality visual UI for our app: clean layouts, strong typography, thoughtful use of color and motion Back every design decision with basic UX reasoning user flows, information hierarchy, usability Use AI tools (for ideation, exploration, content generation, research synthesis, or production speed) as a core part of your workflow. Work closely with product managers and engineers to make sure designs actually ship the way they were intended Contribute to and maintain our design system reuse patterns, flag inconsistencies, and help it scale as the product grows Present and defend your design decisions clearly, with reasoning, not just taste 
 What we're looking for (must-haves: 3+ years of experience as a UI/UX Designer, with a portfolio that shows strong visual/UI craft first Solid understanding of UX fundamentals — flows, hierarchy, usability, basic research methods Comfortable using AI tools in your day-to-day design process (not just aware of them — actually using them to work faster or think better) Ability to take a project from 0 to 1 with minimal hand-holding Strong command over Figma; comfortable with the broader Adobe Creative Suite 
 Good to have (not deal-breakers): Experience designing for fintech or other high-trust, high-stakes products Experience working within or contributing to a design system Exposure to basic user research or usability testing What we're not looking for Someone who only does UX (flows/wireframes) without strong visual execution Someone who treats AI tools as optional or unfamiliar territory Someone who needs a fully scoped brief to start — we want people who can bring clarity to ambiguit

description:
3. Architect View Details Location: Pune (with travel to project sites as required) Project Coordinator : IT / Mixed-Use / Residential Projects 

 Role Overview: 
 We are seeking an experienced Project Coordinator (Architect or Civil Engineer) to manage the design development, statutory approvals, and overall project coordination for large-scale IT parks, mixed-use commercial developments, and high-end residential projects. The role will be based in Pune and will involve close coordination with internal teams, external consultants, and project site teams to ensure smooth transition from concept and design stages through approvals and project kick-off. The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience in handling projects end-to-end in a similar coordination role, ensuring timely delivery, regulatory compliance, and effective stakeholder alignment. 

 Key Responsibilities: 
 

 1. Project Coordination & Planning 
 Act as the central coordination point between design consultants, internal stakeholders, and site teams. Prepare and track project schedules related to design development, approvals, and pre-construction readiness. Ensure alignment between design intent, statutory requirements, and project timelines. 

 2. Design Management 
 Coordinate with architects, structural, MEP, faade, and other consultants to ensure integrated and timely delivery of design packages. Conduct design coordination meetings and ensure closure of action points within defined timelines. 

 3. Statutory Approvals & Compliance 
 Manage and track statutory approvals and submissions with relevant authorities. Coordinate preparation and submission of drawings, documents, and technical clarifications required for approvals. Maintain organized documentation and approval records to support project timelines. 

 4. Site Kick-off & Mobilization 
 Ensure readiness of approved drawings, permits, and documentation prior to construction commencement. Support onboarding and coordination of consultants and contractors during early project phases. 

 5. Reporting & Stakeholder Management 
 Provide regular updates to senior management on project status, approvals, risks, and timelines. Facilitate effective communication between multiple stakeholders to ensure timely decision-making. 

 Experience: 
 812 years of relevant experience in IT parks, mixed-use commercial, or premium residential developments. Must have handled at least one large-scale project from design inception through approvals and site commencement in a project coordination role. 

 Skills & Competencies: 
 Strong understanding of architectural and engineering design coordination. Familiarity with statutory approval processes and local regulatory frameworks. Proficiency in AutoCAD, MS Project/Primavera, and project coordination tools. Strong documentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to manage multiple consultants and timelines effectively
